title: The Death of Nadab and the Rise of Baasha
description: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam, became king over Israel and did evil in the Lord's sight. While he and all Israel were besieging the Philistine city of Gibbethon, Baasha, the son of Ahijah from the house of Issachar, conspired against him and killed him. Baasha became king in his place and wiped out the entire house of Jeroboam, just as the Lord had spoken through His servant the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh, because of the sins that Jeroboam had committed.
